description: Server identity (api-node). Issue 1: POST /users/login must match email and recovery_email, not only username/mobile. Issue 6 (server half): add two auth-gated endpoints so a Google user can set a real mobile verified by an EMAIL OTP. Both grounded in api-node/src/routes/users.ts, mirroring the existing findUserByIdentifier OR and the recovery-email/send + recovery-email/verify handlers. Independent of the mobile FEATs except that FEAT-002's gate screen calls the endpoints added here, so this must land first.
steps: In api-node/src/routes/users.ts, locate POST /users/login (the handler after loginSchema, ~line 143-166). Change the lookup `prisma.user.findFirst({ where: { OR: [{ username: username.toLowerCase() }, { mobile: username }] } })` to compute `const lower = username.toLowerCase();` and use `OR: [{ username: lower }, { mobile: username }, { email: lower }, { recovery_email: lower }]` — the same 4-way OR already used by findUserByIdentifier() in this file. Update the loginSchema inline comment from 'username OR mobile' to 'username OR mobile OR email'. Leave the password check, rider gate, last_login update and issueTokens call unchanged.

Add POST /users/mobile/send (requireAuth) in users.ts, modeled on the recovery-email/send handler: load the current user via BigInt(req.user!.sub); choose target = user.recovery_email || user.email; if no target, return fail(res, 'Add a recovery email first to receive the code.', 400); generate a 6-digit code; prisma.emailOtp.create with { email: target.toLowerCase(), otp, purpose: 'set_mobile', expires_at: new Date(Date.now() + 10*60*1000) }; sendMail(target, '4A Store mobile verification code', `Your 4A Store code is ${otp}. It expires in 10 minutes.`).catch(()=>null); return ok(res, { message: 'Code sent', devOtp: config.env !== 'production' ? otp : undefined }). DO NOT reuse /otp/send (its purpose is 'signup').

Add POST /users/mobile/verify (requireAuth) in users.ts, modeled on recovery-email/verify: zod body schema { mobile: z.string().regex(/^[6-9]\d{9}$/), otp: z.string().trim().regex(/^\d{6}$/) } with a 422 on parse fail; load the current user, compute target = recovery_email || email (422 if none); find the latest unconsumed EmailOtp where email=target.toLowerCase(), purpose='set_mobile', expires_at > now, orderBy id desc; if missing or otp mismatch return fail(res, 'Invalid or expired code.', 422); then in a try/catch call prisma.user.update({ where: { id }, data: { mobile } }) and, on Prisma error code 'P2002', return fail(res, 'This mobile number is already registered to another account.', 409); mark the OTP consumed (prisma.emailOtp.update consumed:true) — do the update + consume consistently (a $transaction like recovery-email/verify is fine, but keep the P2002 catch able to return 409 before consuming); re-read the user and return ok(res, { user: safeUser(updatedUser) }).
Confirm no schema change is needed (User.mobile and EmailOtp.purpose already exist; purpose is a free String). Do NOT edit schema.prisma, do NOT run prisma migrate/db push.
Commit locally on branch identity-checkout-fixes (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: The login handler's findFirst OR includes username (lowercased), mobile (as-is), email (lowercased) and recovery_email (lowercased).
POST /users/mobile/send exists, is requireAuth-gated, creates an EmailOtp with purpose 'set_mobile', and does not call the signup OTP path.

POST /users/mobile/verify exists, is requireAuth-gated, validates /^[6-9]\d{9}$/ mobile, verifies the latest unconsumed 'set_mobile' OTP, updates user.mobile, returns 409 on a P2002 unique collision, consumes the OTP on success, and returns safeUser (no password field).
No schema.prisma edits; no prisma migrate/db push run.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\identity-checkout-fixes\4astore-v2\api-node ; npm run build  (tsc exits 0, no type errors)
cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\identity-checkout-fixes\4astore-v2\api-node ; npx prisma validate  (prints the schema is valid)
findings:
DONE in api-node/src/routes/users.ts. (1) POST /users/login lookup now uses the 4-way OR [username(lower), mobile(as-is), email(lower), recovery_email(lower)] via `const lower = username.toLowerCase()`; schema comment updated to 'username OR mobile OR email'. Password check / rider gate / last_login / issueTokens unchanged. (2) Added two auth-gated endpoints the FEAT-002 mobile gate must call:

POST /api/users/mobile/send  (requireAuth; Authorization: Bearer <access token>, body: none)
  200 ok -> { success:true, data:{ message:'Code sent', devOtp?:string } }  (devOtp present only when config.env !== 'production')
  400 fail 'Add a recovery email first to receive the code.' when the user has neither recovery_email nor email
  404 fail 'User not found'
  Side effect: creates EmailOtp { email: (recovery_email||email).toLowerCase(), otp: 6 digits, purpose:'set_mobile', expires_at: now+10min } and emails it. Does NOT use the signup OTP path.

POST /api/users/mobile/verify  (requireAuth; Authorization: Bearer <access token>)
  body (zod): { mobile: /^[6-9]\d{9}$/, otp: /^\d{6}$/ }
  422 fail 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile and the 6-digit code.' on body parse fail
  422 fail 'Add a recovery email first to receive the code.' if no recovery/primary email
  422 fail 'Invalid or expired code.' if no matching latest-unconsumed set_mobile OTP or otp mismatch
  409 fail 'This mobile number is already registered to another account.' on Prisma P2002 (mobile is @unique) BEFORE the OTP is consumed
  404 fail 'User not found'
  200 ok -> { success:true, data:{ user: safeUser(updatedUser) } }  (updated user, password stripped; mobile is now the real number). OTP is consumed only after a successful user.update.

No schema.prisma change (User.mobile @unique + EmailOtp.purpose free String already exist); no prisma migrate/db push.
Response envelope note for FEAT-002: ok()/fail() wrap payloads as { success, data } / { success:false, error } (see api-node/src/utils/http.ts) — the mobile gate should read res.data.user etc.
ENV NOTE for later server verification: this worktree had no node_modules/.env. I ran `npm install` in api-node, and because the Prisma engine download is blocked by a corporate SSL cert ('unable to get local issuer certificate'), I copied the already-generated client (node_modules/.prisma/client) and the cached engines (node_modules/@prisma/engines: query_engine + schema-engine) from the sibling MAIN tree c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\4astore-v2\api-node (schema.prisma SHA256 verified identical). `prisma validate` also needs a DATABASE_URL env var present (schema-only check, no DB connect); pass a dummy one for the command.
